description: This file provides client-side utility functions for filtering request lists in the Mechanic Portal. It includes functions for normalizing text to facilitate case-insensitive and diacritic-insensitive matching, extracting location information from requests, filtering requests based on location, issue description, and status, as well as counting active filters.

methods.name: normalizeText(v)
methods.description: Normalizes input text by trimming, collapsing whitespace, converting to lowercase, removing diacritics, and stripping punctuation to enable resilient 'contains' matching.

methods.name: containsNormalized(haystack, needle)
methods.description: Checks if the normalized version of the haystack contains the normalized needle.

methods.name: extractLocationText(request)
methods.description: Extracts location text from a request object, supporting nested and flat schema shapes.

methods.name: filterRequests(rows, filters)
methods.description: Filters a list of request objects based on location, issue description, and status filters.

methods.name: countActiveFilters(filters)
methods.description: Counts the number of non-empty filters among location, issue, and status.
